NativePredictionCollection.description:
Every fixed probe retains its own expected measured-attempt identity.

The collection is not a batch reservation or aggregate CPU measurement.
NativePredictionCollection.title: NativePredictionCollection

NativePredictionConfig.description: Fixed counterfactual profile, distinct from purchased-action admission.
NativePredictionConfig.title: NativePredictionConfig

NativePredictionOutcome.description: Complete SCI response or explicit failure; no partial trajectory or accuracy claim.

NativeProbeOutcome.title: NativeProbeOutcome

NativeScoreOutcome.description:
Evaluator-private result, including private reference labels and digests.

No eligibility or fixture accuracy threshold is applied. A poor valid score
remains scored. Only explicit protocol/report projections can be exported
after the study's selection/history freeze; none is online selector feedback.
NativeScoreOutcome.title: NativeScoreOutcome

NativeScoreResult.description: Private work facts count one invocation, separate from evaluator probe diagnostics.
NativeScoreResult.title: NativeScoreResult

NativeScoringInput.description: Evaluator-private actual inputs; never pass this object or its hash to a selector.
NativeScoringInput.title: NativeScoringInput

NativeScoringPolicy.description:
Model-independent frozen recipe, interpreted by unchanged i1_protocol.

The named recipe fixes all 24 public conditions, order, masses and impulses,
41 times (i * .05), integration_dt .01, and the exact existing I1 semantics.
No coefficient, selected candidate, purchased prefix or private world occurs
here. Source identity separately pins the implementation of that recipe.
NativeScoringPolicy.title: NativeScoringPolicy

NativeSpringPool.description: A common ordered coefficient pool, independent of any arm or purchased prefix.
NativeSpringPool.title: NativeSpringPool

NativeWorkFacts.description:
Operation-local facts, not a ledger, timing measurement or proof of execution.

attempt_id is an opaque ledger-issued parent-envelope correlation. Multiple
internal operations may share it; RA-02 owns reservation, measurement and totals.
NativeWorkFacts.title: NativeWorkFacts
